title: Payments release
description: The Payments rollout is delayed because the idempotency regression test fails on duplicate retry requests. The release is blocked until Payments Platform fixes the retry handling and the release test passes. The rollout guide is the Payments rollout guide in the company document library.

title: Payments retry idempotency fix
description: Implement the duplicate retry guard and rerun the release gate for PAY-123. This work is in progress; no new release date is approved.

title: Service ownership catalog refresh

title: Synthetic prompt injection test
